subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: Should a same-session `openclaw agent` CLI dispatch that waits past the lane threshold become a terminal `LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED` busy result, or should it preserve queued execution and only improve timeout/error messaging?
rationale: Current main lacks any user-visible lane-busy signal, but the candidate fix changes the CLI delivery contract and exit behavior, which should be an explicit maintainer decision.

options.title: Land terminal busy contract
options.body: Review and land the linked PR or a replacement that returns a structured busy result for intended source-CLI calls while preserving non-CLI queue behavior.

options.title: Keep queued execution default
options.body: Preserve current waiting semantics and add clearer timeout/disconnect messaging without rejecting queued CLI work at the lane-wait threshold.

options.title: Defer contract change
options.body: Leave the issue open until maintainers decide the exit-code and retry contract before accepting further implementation churn.

recommendation.title: Land terminal busy contract
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR or a replacement that returns a structured busy result for intended source-CLI calls while preserving non-CLI queue behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to this owner for the Gateway-backed CLI relay and adjacent queue behavior, making them the best routing candidate for the CLI/Gateway contract choice.
